purpose: Third fresh generality batch: another new set of real open-source apps pinned to a commit, scanned with an empty ledger and no project-specific rules. Each scanRoot points at one coherent application. Expected route counts were verified by reading each project's route registrations directly from source (router registrations, viewset registrations, method-router chains), never from the scanner output. The batch deliberately spans six languages and eight frameworks and exercises real ORM/DTO data flow, method-router services, autoload plugins, viewset routers, dynamic choices and store-derived responses.

scoring.notes: Deterministic = provable from source. AiReview = a contract the deterministic pass honestly cannot prove from source (here: the Elysia guard POST /name returns a value read from runtime store state); it is routed to the interactive AI gap review where the user accepts/edits/rejects each fragment (accepted fragments carry x-ai-inferred, rejected fragments are never merged). It is reported separately, never silently merged and never hard-coded. Dynamic enum values whose base type is known (DRF language/style choices) keep their deterministic type plus an x-dynamic-enum marker and do not invalidate the schema.

projects.baseline: source-verified per-function Group prefixes: AuthRoutes registers POST /auth/signup and POST /auth/login; TodoRoutes registers POST /todo/create, GET /todo/list, GET /todo/:todoID, PATCH /todo/:todoID, PATCH /todo/:todoID/check, DELETE /todo/:todoID. Local group variables in different functions must not leak prefixes.
three web::resource registrations: GET /, POST /todo, POST /todo/{id}
four POST web::resource routes (/, /extractor, /extractor2, /manual) all taking/returning MyObj; /manual deserializes web::Bytes via serde_json::from_slice::<MyObj>
GET / plus POST /post1, /post2, /post3; the three POST handlers bind web::Form<MyParams> as application/x-www-form-urlencoded
GET and POST /{key} (the latter via post_service on a layered/with_state handler), GET /keys, and an /admin nest with DELETE /admin/keys and DELETE /admin/key/{key}; GET /{key} returns bytes::Bytes

newServer() registers GET/POST /users and GET/PUT/DELETE /users/:id; handlers take *echo.Context (echo v5), return c.JSON of a user from a package map / bindUser and a make([]user) list, DELETE returns 204

@fastify/autoload discovers routes/root.ts (GET /, GET /health/check), routes/example/index.ts (GET /example) and routes/user/index.ts (POST /user/login); autoload dir uses a bare join() and forwarded options carry no prefix

ten Endpoint subclasses each exposing one route: POST /benchmark/codegen/{id}, GET command-handler-1, GET command-handler-2, GET /empty-request, POST /benchmark/ok/{id}, GET /object-request, GET /benchmark/query-binding, POST /benchmark/scoped-validator/{id}, POST /benchmark/struct/{id}, POST /benchmark/throttle/{id}
